description: Turn HTML into clean Markdown: headings, bold/italic, links, lists, code blocks, and blockquotes.

faqs.a: Headings, paragraphs, bold/italic/strikethrough, links, images, ordered/unordered/nested lists, inline code, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, line breaks, and horizontal rules.
HTML is parsed with the browser's own DOMParser, so malformed markup is handled gracefully.
They are dropped; only their text content is kept. Scripts and styles are removed entirely.
faqs.q: What happens to divs and spans?

faqs.a: Yes — everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Paste HTML into the input box.
Copy the Markdown or download it as a .md file.
title: HTML to Markdown Converter
